prompt: Single continuous shot. Opens mid-action: garlic slices sliding off a knife blade directly into a wide pan of shimmering olive oil, an immediate aggressive sizzle, slices turning gold at the edges. Red pepper flakes scattered from height, blooming red in the oil. Spaghetti lifted dripping from boiling water and dropped straight into the pan. Money shot: a ladle of starchy pasta water hitting the hot oil — a violent hiss and cloud of backlit steam — as tongs toss everything into glossy emulsified strands that lift and fall in macro, gold clinging to every noodle. Final beat: the twirled nest on a plate, parsley falling, gloss catching the light. Warm 3200K side light, deep shadows, film grain. Dominant sound: the garlic sizzle, then the water hiss. No speech, no voice, no narration, no dialogue, no music.
